description: Study 1 (PROTOCOL.md 5.1): six debugging stories, each with its own plot skeleton (harness/src/ceval/stories.py), two sessions per story; 17 planted details and 3 lures per session; 3 rounds of realistic work, each opened by a competing episode and followed by a compaction and a probe. plant_tokens and round_tokens are real tokens, converted with the measured chars_per_token (docs/build/stories-tokcheck.txt). Extended to 18 sessions on 2026-10-06 (3 fact-value sets per story; sessions 12-17 appended, sessions 0-11 unchanged).
